checklist.why: Purpose present; does not send animal rows to TaskRow or history to Log.
No when / when-not across the three roots and the look-alikes.
Parts named (icon/code, title, line 2, chip/trailing, trail) and all shown in the preview.
rowSelect, rowAction and the code/token litter row are used on no screen; TaskRow's tick and door+act do those jobs instead.
Pressed, focus, disabled and busy are stated but not rendered in the preview.
rowAction's act button is 101x44; inspection.review-selected's Remove is 53x44.
Disabled is opacity .5 only, which the DS state law forbids ("nothing else is ever greyed").
Truncation (ellipsis) and wrap:true both stated and shown.
button / label roots, aria-current, aria-labelledby for the act and the focus ring are stated.
Base row CSS uses raw #eef2e7, #53674a, #f1f5eb, #eaf2e5, #526847, 68px and 12x14px; only the candidate additions use tokens.
Links ADR 0002 only; no classification against TaskRow, TaskDay items or the Home task card.
Only the default faces are rendered at 375.

variants.name: navigation row (icon tile, title, line 2, chevron; in rowGroup)
findings: Closest to ready, but the README's own Don't says "no icons on list rows" while this variant is defined by its icon tile.

variants.name: summary/count row (trailing number; div at 0, button above 0)
findings: A zero row becomes a non-button div with no cue; the empty law says it should be absent, or the README should allow it.

variants.name: animal / litter row (code column, chip, token lines): row({code})
findings: No screen. The real animal row is TaskRow (piglet-processing.pen-list) and farrowing's .sow-row (farrowing.room).

variants.name: selectable row (rowSelect, checkbox)
findings: No screen. Look-alikes: TaskRow trail "tick"; inspection's label.check-target.pen-select-target on feed-plan.* screens.

variants.name: action row (rowAction, door + one-tap button)
findings: No screen. Look-alikes: TaskDay items with act (piglet-processing.sheet-todo, sheet-done); inspection.review-selected li.st-row + Remove (53x44). The TaskRow README says door+act "replaces SentriUI.rowAction".

variants.name: done/record row (trail edit, wrap)
findings: Preview only; done rows in use are TaskRow (Done chip + edit trail) on piglet-processing.pen-list.

findings.text: Two row families do the same jobs: Row's candidates (code row, rowSelect, rowAction, done row) have no screen, while TaskRow (animal row, tick, door, door+act) and TaskDay items serve every real task screen. The owner's rule is one implementation per job.
findings.fix: Pick the owner: make TaskRow's animal/tick/door/act faces variants of Row (one implementation, Row the base) and delete row({code}), rowSelect and rowAction, or the reverse. Until then mark the three candidates "no screen".

findings.text: Look-alikes outside both families: Home's task card (workbench.today, 88-235px buttons), farrowing's .sow-row (farrowing.room), inspection's checkbox pen rows (feed-plan.*) and the review-list row with Remove (inspection.review-selected).
findings.fix: Classify each in Row's README: Home task card = separate component (a card, not a row); .sow-row = the animal variant; checkbox pen rows = the selectable variant; the review row = the action variant.

findings.text: Disabled is opacity .5, against the DS state law; the README itself says to prefer omission.
findings.fix: Remove the disabled face; keep the attribute for semantics only and require a reason line.

findings.text: Second targets under 48px: rowAction act 101x44, review-row Remove 53x44.
findings.fix: Act and inline buttons take min-height control-height (48px).

findings.text: The README contradicts itself: the anatomy has an icon tile and the Don'ts say "no icons on list rows"; five screens use icon rows.
findings.fix: Restate: icon tiles only on navigation rows (lists of places or actions); never on animal or record rows.

findings.text: Base row CSS uses raw colours and sizes; the preview injects inline-styled trailing HTML.
findings.fix: Use row-icon-bg, row-icon-ink, press, green-wash, current-marker, row-min and space-row-y/x; pass a typed trailing {text, tone} in the preview.

proposals.name: TaskRow (animal, tick, door, door+act) with Row (code row, rowSelect, rowAction, done row)
proposals.why: Same jobs, two implementations; only TaskRow has screens.

proposals.name: Home task card
proposals.why: A different job (summarise one task type with progress and timing) in a card, not a row; already named as a Home pattern in the atlas.

proposals.name: Row: selectable (adopt inspection's checkbox pen rows)
proposals.why: Bulk selection on the feed-plan and inspection screens is hand-built.
